# SimJury

> SimJury is one account-free fictional courtroom experience. Eleven Minutes unfolds over five weekday court sessions and a weekend jury deliberation. The player listens to both sides, tests admitted evidence with eleven authored jurors, and may return Murder, manslaughter, Not Guilty, or remain unable to agree.

SimJury is served entirely as static assets. Progress, private notes and ballots
stay in the browser; an explicit local export/import file provides device
transfer. Reviewed media comes from one pinned GitHub Release. There is no runtime AI,
server-side analytics, account, multiplayer room, waitlist or gameplay API. Masked
client-side Microsoft Clarity analytics is enabled by default and may observe control
interaction, including ballot-control interaction; stored ballot choices, progress,
notes and free-text reasoning remain local. A browser-local opt-out is available.

## Canonical public pages

- [Court Week](https://simjury.com/): The seven-session audio-first courtroom and deliberation experience.
- [Privacy](https://simjury.com/privacy/): Local state, explicit device transfer, static delivery and media-request boundaries.

## Site access

- [Complete machine-readable site guide](https://simjury.com/llms-full.txt)
- [XML sitemap](https://simjury.com/sitemap.xml)
- [Robots policy](https://simjury.com/robots.txt)

## Boundaries

These guides do not reproduce or link case facts, testimony, exhibits, juror
rules, ballots, outcomes or analysis. `/jury/`, `/today/`, `/play/` and `/install/` are
compatibility redirects to the canonical HTTPS apex.
